name: Deadly Gambit (Combat)
body:
By taking a loose, less defensive stance while fighting you can create openings when your enemy attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Power Attack, (base attack bonus +11 or Fighter level 9th).

Benefit(s): When you use the Power Attack feat you may elect to leave an opening for your opponents. Each enemy you attack this round gains a bonus on attack and damage rolls against you equal to the penalty on attack rolls normally imposed by your Power Attack feat until the start of your next turn. Each time they attack you they provoke an attack of opportunity from you, providing you have one remaining. You must declare the use of this feat when you declare the use of Power Attack for the round. Abilities or feats that reduce the penalty from Power Attack do not reduce the bonus that your enemies receive.
